note: Fixed seed sets for the randomized API scenarios in backend/tests/scenarios. A scenario opts in with a top-level `randomize: {seeds: <set>}` block and runs once per seed in that set. The default set is `ci`; PICASU_RANDOM_SEEDS overrides it with a set name or a comma-separated seed list (used to replay one failure). `resolvesTo` is a golden table: it records the format each seed must select, so a change to the capability manifest or to the selector's mapping fails a test instead of silently re-pointing every recorded scenario at a different format. Re-derive it deliberately, and extend the `ci` set so a newly covered format is exercised on every pull request.
